title: PR #5853: Copilot FR link gaps in identity and resync paths
body: Found during hostile MRB review of PR #5853, related to open issue #5847. Evidence: common/scripts/gitclaim.py treats any copilot/fr-N-* head ref as Copilot without checking the PR author, so a non-Copilot PR can settle a held FR. Separately, github-resync derives refs only from title/body and persists a sparse catalog item, so a head-only Copilot PR missed by webhook cannot be matched by stuck-sweep or dispatch. Fix: require verified Copilot author identity for branch-based matches and propagate head-derived refs plus author/head metadata through resync claims and catalog. Add resync and spoofed-author tests.
